scope: Public primary literature, official labels and public competition code. No subject records. Claim summaries are paraphrases. Reading depth is explicit; metadata verification does not establish claim support.

sources.title: Phase II trial of temsirolimus in children with high-grade glioma, neuroblastoma and rhabdomyosarcoma
sources.claim: None of three tumour cohorts met the prespecified early-response threshold; one RMS participant had a later partial response confirmed at week 18.
sources.limit: A late response must not be erased by saying no RMS response ever occurred. Small, heavily pretreated cohorts and no randomized comparator; no BUB1B-specific efficacy evidence.

sources.title: Phase II study of cixutumumab in combination with temsirolimus in pediatric patients and young adults with recurrent or refractory sarcoma: A report from the Children's Oncology Group
sources.claim: No objective responses among 43 response-evaluable participants; 16% progression-free at 12 weeks. Mucositis, electrolyte disturbances and myelosuppression occurred.
sources.limit: Mixed sarcomas, unselected for BUB1B, no randomized comparator; stable disease is not an objective response or proof of benefit.

sources.title: Combined MTOR and autophagy inhibition: phase I trial of hydroxychloroquine and temsirolimus in patients with advanced solid tumors and melanoma
sources.claim: Tests the feasibility and pharmacodynamics of combined mTOR and autophagy inhibition in adults.
sources.limit: No pediatric MVA/RMS efficacy inference; target engagement and stable disease are not proof of clinical benefit or genotype selectivity.

sources.title: Chemical Chaperones Reduce ER Stress and Restore Glucose Homeostasis in a Mouse Model of Type 2 Diabetes
sources.claim: Chemical chaperones including phenylbutyrate reduced ER stress in metabolic models.
sources.limit: ER-stress modulation does not establish folding or function of a cytosolic checkpoint protein; substantial mechanistic extrapolation.

sources.title: Constitutional aneuploidy and cancer predisposition caused by biallelic mutations in BUB1B
sources.claim: Biallelic BUB1B disruption is associated with constitutional aneuploidy and cancer predisposition.
sources.limit: Gene-level association; not functional validation of the submitted pair.

sources.title: Molecular causes for BUBR1 dysfunction in the human cancer predisposition syndrome mosaic variegated aneuploidy
sources.model: MVA-derived cell lines and protein replacement
sources.claim: Studied MVA mutants affect protein abundance or checkpoint/attachment functions; wild-type replacement restores checkpoint activity.
sources.limit: Specific mutants studied are not interchangeable with Asn1002Lys; transformed cells and replacement assays are not therapeutic trials.

sources.title: The vertebrate mitotic checkpoint protein BUBR1 is an unusual pseudokinase
sources.claim: Found structural roles for the kinase-like domain and catalysis dispensable under the tested conditions.
sources.limit: Catalytic interpretation is contested by later work; do not declare activity universally absent.

sources.title: BubR1 phosphorylates CENP-E as a switch enabling the transition from lateral association to end-on capture of spindle microtubules
sources.model: Drosophila-domain structure, biochemical and cellular assays
sources.claim: Reports catalytic activity and CENP-E phosphorylation, opposing a categorical kinase-inactive interpretation.
sources.limit: Does not show that inhibiting BUBR1 repairs human BUB1B deficiency or validates Asn1002Lys.

sources.title: BUBR1 Pseudokinase Domain Promotes Kinetochore PP2A-B56 Recruitment, Spindle Checkpoint Silencing, and Chromosome Alignment
sources.claim: C-terminal domain integrity supports KARD phosphorylation, PP2A-B56 recruitment and chromosome alignment.
sources.limit: Not an assay of the submitted missense allele; checkpoint timing is multidimensional.

sources.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome
sources.claim: Allele-dependent phenotypes; mTORC1 activation in muscle of heterozygous X753 mice, not a universal consequence of reduced BUBR1.
sources.limit: Mouse L1002P models human L1012P, not Asn1002Lys. No rapalog rescue experiment in this paper. Figure 5 profiling used three mice per genotype. See corrigendum.

sources.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome
sources.claim: Corrects duplicated sample images in Figure 2E and the corresponding mitotic-index method.
sources.limit: Correction concerns Figure 2E, not a new replication or drug-rescue experiment.

sources.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan
sources.model: cell assays and mouse NAD/SIRT2 manipulation
sources.claim: SIRT2-linked deacetylation affects BubR1 abundance; NMN increases abundance; SIRT2 transgene extends hypomorphic-mouse lifespan. Nicotinamide reduces abundance in tested cells.
sources.limit: NMN administration is not the lifespan experiment. Nicotinamide cell exposure was high. Neither observation establishes a human MVA treatment.

sources.title: Identification of aneuploidy-selective antiproliferation compounds
sources.model: trisomic mouse fibroblasts and human cancer lines
sources.claim: AICAR, 17-AAG and chloroquine showed aneuploidy-associated antiproliferative effects in tested models.
sources.limit: Chloroquine is not hydroxychloroquine; trisomy is not equivalent to all CIN or MVA. Nonmalignant trisomic-cell sensitivity is a safety concern, not tumour specificity.

sources.title: Randomized Phase II Trial of Bevacizumab or Temsirolimus in Combination With Chemotherapy for First Relapse Rhabdomyosarcoma: A Report From the Children's Oncology Group
sources.model: randomized phase II selection trial ARST0921
sources.claim: Temsirolimus-containing therapy had better event-free survival than bevacizumab-containing therapy with a shared chemotherapy backbone.
sources.limit: 87 randomized; active comparator, not chemotherapy alone; no significant overall-survival difference. Does not establish an isolated temsirolimus effect or BUB1B-specific benefit.

sources.title: Addition of temsirolimus to chemotherapy in children, adolescents, and young adults with intermediate-risk rhabdomyosarcoma (ARST1431): a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial from the Children's Oncology Group
sources.claim: Among 297 evaluable participants, addition of temsirolimus did not significantly improve three-year EFS: 66.8% versus 64.8%; HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.58-1.26; p=0.44.
sources.limit: 325 enrolled; distinct setting/backbone from relapse trial. Not proof of zero effect in every subgroup, but opposes blanket efficacy claims.

sources.title: Initial testing (stage 1) of the proteasome inhibitor bortezomib by the pediatric preclinical testing program
sources.model: pediatric cancer cell and xenograft panels
sources.claim: Strong in-vitro activity translated to limited solid-tumour xenograft activity.
sources.limit: Mouse exposures and tumour types do not establish BUB1B-MVA efficacy; leukemia activity is not RMS activity.

sources.title: High-dose metformin induces a low-glucose dependent genotoxic stress
sources.claim: Millimolar metformin perturbed checkpoint-related expression and induced glucose-dependent genotoxic stress, including in non-cancer cells.
sources.limit: High in-vitro exposures cannot establish clinical benefit or harm at ordinary therapeutic exposure.

sources.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders
sources.claim: Engineered clearance of p16-positive cells delayed selected age-associated pathologies.
sources.limit: Genetic cell ablation is not evidence that dasatinib/quercetin is safe or effective in a child with MVA.

sources.title: PTC124 targets genetic disorders caused by nonsense mutations
sources.claim: Early preclinical PTC124 work supported premature-stop readthrough as a therapeutic concept.
sources.limit: Different gene, transcript and models; does not demonstrate Leu737Ter readthrough or functional BUBR1. Later regulatory evidence limits translation.

sources.title: TORISEL (temsirolimus) US prescribing information
sources.claim: Approved for advanced renal cell carcinoma; renal failure, infection and metabolic risks; pediatric solid-tumour effectiveness unestablished.
sources.limit: No objective responses in the reported pediatric recurrent RMS monotherapy cohort. Approval is not for MVA or RMS.

sources.title: Everolimus tablets for oral suspension US prescribing information
sources.claim: Pediatric TSC indications demonstrate formulation and monitoring experience; infection, renal failure, stomatitis and interaction risks remain.
sources.limit: Different disease and indication. Not approval for MVA, muscle wasting, nephrocalcinosis or RMS.

sources.title: PLAQUENIL (hydroxychloroquine sulfate) US prescribing information
sources.claim: Malaria and specified adult autoimmune indications; QT, cardiomyopathy, retinal, muscle/nerve and renal toxicity warnings.
sources.limit: Pediatric malaria indication does not establish pediatric cancer safety, exposure or efficacy.

sources.title: VELCADE (bortezomib) US prescribing information
sources.claim: Multiple myeloma and mantle-cell lymphoma indications; neuropathy and cytopenia risks.
sources.limit: Not an approved constitutional BUBR1 stabilizer; pediatric safety/effectiveness not established in label.

sources.title: Metformin hydrochloride tablets US prescribing information
sources.claim: Type 2 diabetes indication includes patients ten years and older; renal-function restrictions and lactic-acidosis warning.
sources.limit: Renal calcification does not itself establish impaired filtration; no current eGFR or patient-specific eligibility is available.

sources.title: Gentamicin sulfate injection US label
sources.claim: Antibacterial use; nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity and neuromuscular risks.
sources.limit: No BUB1B readthrough approval or established chronic rescue window.

sources.title: BUPHENYL (sodium phenylbutyrate) US label
sources.claim: Urea-cycle disorder therapy; sodium burden and caution in renal insufficiency.
sources.limit: Neither urea-cycle indication nor general chemical-chaperone reasoning demonstrates mutant BUBR1 rescue.

sources.title: Translarna: European Commission non-renewal decision
sources.claim: EU conditional marketing authorisation was not renewed on 28 March 2025 because efficacy was not confirmed.
sources.limit: Do not describe it as currently EU-approved; other jurisdictions require separate verification.

sources.title: NCT01222715 ARST0921 trial registration
sources.claim: Registers the comparison of bevacizumab and temsirolimus with vinorelbine/cyclophosphamide in recurrent/refractory RMS.
sources.limit: Not a recruitment or eligibility recommendation.

sources.title: NCT02567435 ARST1431 trial registration
sources.claim: Registers the intermediate-risk RMS comparison including temsirolimus.
sources.limit: Registration is not positive efficacy evidence; read the phase III publication.

sources.title: Official Track 2 submission instructions
sources.claim: Report, GitHub link, three-minute hosted pitch and AI-use disclosure; latest entry reviewed.
sources.limit: Config separately sets the maximum to three. No upload has been performed for Track 2.
